title: The first PR is won or lost at picking the project
takeaway: Pick an active, mid-sized project with a good first issue, then keep the change small enough to review.
sources: The main reason developers fail to make their first contribution is choosing the wrong project.
Not reading this is the fastest way to get your PR closed immediately.
Scope creep is the single most common reason PRs get rejected or stall.
For now: find one project, fix one thing, open one PR.

nodes.label: Pick an active, not massive project
nodes.note: 10-200 contributors, a good first issue label

nodes.label: Read CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.note: Skipping it gets a PR closed fastest

nodes.label: Open the PR linked to the issue
nodes.note: Closes #482 links the PR and closes the issue on merge

nodes.label: Respond to every review comment
nodes.note: Requested changes are collaboration, not rejection
